_about: The one source of the pipeline picture. scripts/gen-pipeline-blocks.mjs renders a block from this file into every backend group and frontend feature README (between <!-- pipeline:begin --> and <!-- pipeline:end -->); quality/check_docs.mjs fails when a block is missing or stale. Stages match project-docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE_TIMELINE.md section 1b. Edit here, then run: node scripts/gen-pipeline-blocks.mjs

backend/pipeline.part: the selector (1), the story writer and forecasts (2), story analysis, country briefings, drift notes and the story web (3)
backend/pipeline.timeline: writes no events; its raw rows are the source of entry, story_born, read_changed, chapter, forecast_drawn, country_read_changed, link_confirmed, read only through world/

backend/situations.part: the map ingest and GDACS ingest (1), the map tracker (2)
backend/situations.timeline: writes no events yet; future source of situation events; the map becomes the Map view later

backend/predictions.part: forecast settling and the track-record snapshot
backend/predictions.timeline: writes no events; PRED# and Q# verdicts are the source of forecast_drawn, verdict, correction

backend/shared.part: world/, the only reader of the raw tables, plus the shared rules and the S3 helpers
backend/shared.timeline: writes no events; every other stage reads raw tables only through world/

backend/record.part: newsStoryRecord, the only writer of the timeline and its stored views
backend/record.timeline: writes the timeline (record/timeline) and the story, index and corrections views

backend/board.part: the board's Lambda (boards, follows, presets, connect)
backend/board.timeline: writes no events; reads through world/ until the Index and Story views exist

backend/weekly.part: the analyst's weekly: schema, section model, pull, check, publish
backend/weekly.timeline: writes the Week view (weekly/); reads through world/ until the timeline exists

backend/read-api.part: the read proxy and the per-user endpoints that serve every page
backend/read-api.timeline: writes no events; serves raw tables today; target: serve the Story, Country, Today and Index views

backend/distribution.part: the weekly email, the old weekly brief, breaking alerts and social posts
backend/distribution.timeline: writes no events; consumers moving to the Week, Today and Story views

backend/monitoring.part: model guard, freshness monitor, error digest, audits
backend/monitoring.timeline: writes no events; must alarm when a stage fails (ARCHITECTURE_TIMELINE section 7.4)

backend/membership-studio.part: billing (Polar) and the retired Studio Lambda

backend/economy-parked.timeline: parked; writes no events; reads none

features/home.timeline: reads today's topics from raw tables; target: Today view

features/map.timeline: reads world/latest.json from the map pipeline; target: Map view

features/threads.part: the story page and the stories list
features/threads.timeline: rebuilds story history from raw tables; target: Story view

features/countries.timeline: reads country rows from raw tables; target: Country view

features/briefings.part: the daily and weekly briefs page
features/briefings.timeline: reads the briefs; target: Today and Week views

features/track-record.timeline: reads predictions/track_record.json; target: Track record view

features/board.timeline: reads boards via newsBoard; target: Index and Story views

features/account.timeline: reads country history and prefs from raw tables; target: Country and Board views

features/breaking.timeline: reads breaking alerts; not a timeline view

features/static.timeline: reads the daily brief only; not a timeline view

features/analysis-studio.part: shared-run pages of the retired Studio
